{{Top|leg}}
The '''Lepido Program''' was one of the common military encryption codes used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Zakarisz Ghent]], the renowned computer [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]], managed to crack this code while on a mission with [[Talon Karrde]].
